dependency: Task 188 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 193 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Existing points remain search anchors only and every row stays NOT_BOUND.

features.name: SEGRO Park Rainham
features.official_source_evidence: SEGRO is the primary industrial-property operator source for the Rainham park identity and property offering.
features.classification_finding: The tracked entity is an industrial park containing multiple buildings or units, not one Industrial Unit. A named unit must be selected before exact geometry binding.

features.name: Eldon Square Shopping Centre
features.official_source_evidence: The official Eldon Square domain presents the Newcastle shopping destination, stores, food and visitor information.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. Exact shopping-centre and parcel boundaries remain pending and must not be inferred from the existing point.

features.name: One Angel Square
features.official_source_evidence: NOMA and Co-operative Group building records identify One Angel Square as the Co-operative Group head-office building in Manchester.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. The individual One Angel Square footprint must remain separate from the wider mixed-use NOMA estate.

features.name: Ightham Mote
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Ightham Mote as an outstanding 14th-century moated manor house at Mote Road, Ivy Hatch, Sevenoaks, Kent.
features.classification_finding: The standalone historic-house identity is strong, but current heritage visitor use requires a documented taxonomy decision before preserving Detached Home as an ordinary residential type.

features.name: Lyme Park
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Lyme as a historic house, garden and estate in Cheshire and Greater Manchester.
features.classification_finding: The principal house is a standalone historic mansion, but the tracked name covers a wider estate and current visitor property. The house must be separated from gardens and parkland and the Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.

features.name: 25 Bank Street, Canary Wharf
features.official_source_evidence: Current corporate and authoritative building records identify 25 Bank Street as JPMorgan's Canary Wharf office tower and European-headquarters location during the research pass.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. Future headquarters planning does not justify changing the current building type; exact tower footprint evidence remains pending.
